Nagare 1.2.1 fixes playback and subtitles repeatedly switching between media tabs in the same browser.

- Jellyfin and Emby can report multiple browser tabs under one session ID. Nagare now keeps their different items as separate entries, retaining each for up to 30 seconds between check-ins so automatic and manual selection stay stable.
- Choose a tab's entry by its title to keep mining that item. Newly started playback can take over in automatic mode; stale, disconnected, and unloaded sessions are released.
- Plex uses its playback-instance ID to keep simultaneous sessions separate, including tabs playing the same item. Websocket progress updates apply only to the selected playback instance.
- Subtitle selection uses the selected item's observation even while another tab is checking in. Remote playback controls are unavailable while multiple entries share one server control ID, and return when that ID is unique again.

Verified with 100 backend tests, 11 frontend tests, and a Windows frontend production build, including regression coverage for alternating browser check-ins, manual selection, episode changes, session expiry, and Plex websocket isolation.
